neighbours.label: a negation word (not, cannot, never) right after a modal or auxiliary verb
fire: As a result, these problems cannot be solved by lowering the rate.
The storm could not keep the fishermen from going out to sea.
A painter's private life should not change how we judge the work.
In his view, the delay did not affect the right to cancel.
Their jealousy will never discourage you from your goals.
The committee would not accept the late application.
Such a small change does not alter the overall result.
The engine must not be started before the oil is checked.
quiet: As a result, these problems can be solved by lowering the rate.
The storm could keep the fishermen from going out to sea.
A painter's private life should change how we judge the work.
In his view, the delay did affect the right to cancel.
Their jealousy will always encourage you toward your goals.
The committee would accept the late application.
Such a small change does alter the overall result.
The engine must be started before the oil is checked.
